scientific_integrity: The submitted complete proof and finite verifier are internally reviewed, not externally verified. Classical random affine contraction and general multiplicative-noise heavy tails are acknowledged; only method-specific exact phase geometry and reset-curve law are proposed as new.
scientific_limitations: Only scalar quadratic and iid symmetric two-point strictly convex sample curvatures, exact Gaussian reuse, exact arithmetic; characterizes contractive windows but does not rule out invariant measures outside them; no multivariate or finite-precision claim. The oracle has state-dependent unbounded variance and is outside the source paper uniform-variance hypothesis.
title: Disconnected contractive windows and an exact reset-curve moment law for stochastic-gradient Leimkuhler–Matthews
